svg.title: TabFM vs Kumo Tabular medium
svg.desc: Model A: TabFM - classifier. Model B: Kumo Tabular medium - classifier. Symbols in shapes: B: ensemble members (batch); n: rows in the context (train + test); p: raw features; F: feature groups; E: embedding width; n_test: test rows (the rows being predicted); R: rows; C: columns. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); SwiGLU: gated linear unit with a Swish activation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads). How to read: model A, its stages and its fact values; model B, its stages and its fact values; stages are paired by kind and attention axis, in order, not by name: a pair is the same kind of block in the same place, not necessarily the same design; matched: same kind and axis, and the same number of stacked blocks; N vs M: same kind and axis, with N stacked blocks in A and M in B; only A / only B: a stage with no counterpart in the other model; facts: shared (the same value), different, or one side (reported by one model only, shown as --); alternating: Column block and Row block take turns, one of each per repeat, rather than one stack after the other; on each card: × N stacked blocks and the axis its attention runs over, then its output shape; top right, its exact parameter count.
